subject: general
question: India's first indigenous Aircraft Carrier, _____, conducted its maiden sea travel in August 2021 marking a significant step towards making military equipment in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**INS Vikrant**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **INS Vikrant** is India's first indigenous Aircraft Carrier.
 
• It conducted its **maiden sea travel in August 2021**, marking a significant step towards making military equipment in India.
 
• The carrier has been built by **Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL)** and signifies a major milestone in India's self-reliance in defense manufacturing.
 
• It is named after **India's first aircraft carrier** which played a key role in the 1971 war.
 
• INS Vikrant will contribute significantly to the **Indian Navy's operational capabilities** and maritime security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aircraft carriers** are crucial for power projection and maintaining a naval presence in strategic regions.
 
• The construction of INS Vikrant involved **collaboration among various public and private sector enterprises** in India.
 
• The carrier is equipped with modern systems and technologies, including a **ski-jump for launching aircraft** and advanced radar systems.
 
• Its induction into the Indian Navy is expected to enhance **India's maritime capabilities** and contribute to regional stability.
 
• The indigenous construction of such a complex warship showcases India's **engineering and manufacturing prowess** in the defense sector.
